system.description: By mixing and slowly burning a trace of your own blood with a Blood Trait taken from your victim, you guarantee automatic victory in the very next challenge you bring against that victim — one automatic success and no more, usable only where a test would normally apply. The effect cannot be stacked, saved for a called shot, or invoked twice against the same subject at once, and it expires unused at sunrise.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
